div.div:
Non-Functional Targets
• P50 < 2 s simple query
• P95 < 10 s multi-hop
• 100 concurrent agents
• 99.9% multi-AZ availability
• Data residency in AWS partition
• 21 CFR Part 11 audit
• WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility
• Zero-trust posture
• KMS-encrypted everywhere
• CMK 90-day rotation

■ Networking (VPC, ALB, API GW, PrivateLink)

■ Mgmt & Governance (CW, X-Ray, Config)
■ Developer Tools (CodePipeline, CodeBuild)
